truth.neverRule: A dash, never a made-up zero.
truth.verifiedRule: Success only after the vehicle confirms the value.

initial.resetHelp: Queues the value this parameter had at the last complete download, {initial}. Nothing is written until you press Write.
initial.resetAllHelp: Queues the initial value of every parameter that has changed since the last complete download, except the vehicle's own bookkeeping (STAT_*, MIS_TOTAL, FENCE_TOTAL, RALLY_TOTAL, LOG_LASTFILE, and what the metadata marks read-only or volatile), which can still be reset one by one. Nothing is written until you press Write.
initial.resetAllNone: No parameter has changed from its initial value.
initial.queued: {count} queued to go back to their initial values. Press Write to send them.

empty.title: No parameters yet
empty.none: Connect a vehicle to read its parameters.
empty.loading: The parameters are on their way.
empty.failed: The download failed. Press Download to try again.

noMatch.title: No parameter matches
noMatch.help: Try another name, or another group.

params.metadataNone: 0 of {total} parameters matched: none of the {known} the file describes is a parameter of this vehicle.

staged.writing: Writing… waiting for the vehicle to read each value back.

staged.leftOut: {count} left out: the vehicle already had their values when you confirmed.

staged.stopped: Stopped there: the rest weren't written.
